# PDF plot fixtures

Single-page, vector-heavy Matplotlib PDFs used to exercise the PDF reader on
real plots rather than synthetic letter pages (zoom, scale-and-swap, region
rendering).

## `dphi_GRANIITTI_MC.pdf`

A one-page Matplotlib export of the azimuthal-angle difference distribution
(`dPhi`) from the GRANIITTI Monte Carlo.
